loss.note: main loss is listwise KL(teacher_soft || softmax(student/T)) scaled by T^2; score MSE is off unless score_mse_weight > 0

optim.note: model selection uses the val split only; the test split is evaluated once after the best epoch is frozen

l2_baseline.definition: per-group L2 norm of group_mean; equals hardware_regular_token_selector.group_l2_saliency on the [G,4,1024] broadcast

matched_real_budget.definition: R = real_group_count; selected real groups vs teacher top-R. Fair real-vs-real comparison.

total_budget_coverage.definition: selected real groups vs teacher top-K; context groups occupy part of K, so this is a coverage upper bound, not a full score.
